neighbours.label: the stem ' minim' / ' maxim' of minimise/maximise (optimisation verbs), and the slot just before such a verb
fire: The algorithm finds the weights by minimising the total squared error.
Directors are expected to focus on maximising returns for shareholders.
Good planning helps the team keep costs down while minimising delays.
The solver returns the point that minimizes the cost function.
Farmers rotate crops with the aim of maximising long-term yields.
Careful packing minimises the risk of damage during shipping.
The new tax scheme maximises the allowance each family can claim.
We fit the curve by minimising the negative log-likelihood.
quiet: The algorithm finds the weights by reducing the total squared error.
Directors are expected to focus on increasing returns for shareholders.
Good planning helps the team keep costs down while avoiding delays.
The solver returns the point with the lowest value of the cost function.
Farmers rotate crops with the aim of improving long-term yields.
Careful packing lowers the risk of damage during shipping.
The new tax scheme raises the allowance each family can claim.
We fit the curve by optimising the log-likelihood.

notes: spellings chosen so 'minim'/'maxim' are their own tokens (card shows minim|ising, minim|izes); the - pole is the 'as little/compact as possible' frame
